name: dyoe-trust-mcp

tools.name: dyoe_verify
tools.description: Use when an agent is about to trust or pay a new website, merchant or counterparty: a trust check before payment. Is this website or business a scam? Fraud, phishing and rug-risk screen of a domain or URL. Returns verdict (safe/caution/avoid), trust_score, domain age, red_flags and a signed attestation. Proceed on safe, pause on caution, stop on avoid. Input: ?target=domain Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

target.description: Domain or URL to trust-check (e.g. stripe.com)

tools.name: dyoe_transaction
tools.description: Use when an agent needs a payment preflight: check before sending money to a merchant or wallet. One preflight transaction call: is the counterparty site legit, is the payee wallet OFAC-sanctioned or an empty, disposable address, is the amount over the policy line? Returns proceed/caution/stop, reasons and a signed attestation: one go/no-go instead of three calls. Input: ?domain=merchant.com&wallet=0x...&amount=500 Price: $0.10 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_wallet
tools.description: Use when an agent needs a wallet risk check before sending funds to a crypto address. Screens the address against the OFAC sanctions list and reads its on-chain footprint on Base (tx count, balance, contract or not; flags an empty, disposable address), with a human-vouch overlay. Returns verdict (safe/caution/avoid), sanctioned flag, on_chain activity, red_flags and a signed attestation. Input: ?address=0x... Price: $0.05 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_approve
tools.description: Use when an agent needs a yes or no on an action before it acts, without waiting for a person. Approves or denies instantly against a human-set policy: a trust check on the counterparty plus an amount limit. Returns approved/denied/review_required with reasons and a signed receipt; anything over the policy line or with a caution counterparty escalates to /review. Input: ?action=&counterparty=&amount= (counterparty required) Price: $0.02 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

action.description: What the agent wants to do (e.g. pay invoice)

counterparty.description: Domain or wallet on the other side (required) (e.g. stripe.com)

tools.name: dyoe_review
tools.description: Use when the stakes are high enough that a named human should sign off before an agent acts. A person reviews the action and counterparty and approves or denies; poll /api/task?id=<id> for the signed receipt. A counterparty that fails the trust check is denied at once. Input: ?action=&counterparty=&amount= (counterparty required) Price: $15.00 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

action.description: What a named human should review and sign off on (e.g. approve vendor contract)

counterparty.description: Domain or wallet on the other side (e.g. stripe.com)

tools.name: dyoe_contacts
tools.description: Use when an agent needs an email lookup or phone lookup for a business website. Extracts public business emails, phone numbers and social profiles from the page plus up to 4 same-site contact/about pages, then its privacy page if those list none. Verified or free: if no email or phone is found, or the site blocks us, the payment is not settled. Batch-safe contact enrichment for autonomous agents. Input: website URL. Returns structured JSON. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

url.description: Site to pull emails/phones/socials from (e.g. https://stripe.com)

tools.name: dyoe_intel
tools.description: Use when an agent needs a background check on a company or website before dealing with it. One call: what they do, legitimacy verdict, domain age, how to reach them, social presence, scam red flags. Sources disclosed, not a black box: RDAP registry domain age, HTTPS reachability, on-page contact signals, DYOE human-vouch registry. Input: ?target=domain Price: $0.10 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

target.description: Company or website for a deep dossier (e.g. stripe.com)

tools.name: dyoe_merchant
tools.description: Use when a shopping agent must verify seller trust before paying an online store. Is this store safe to buy from? Returns safe_to_buy, a trust verdict (safe/caution/avoid), trust_score, domain age, red_flags and store signals (cart/checkout, returns policy, payment methods mentioned on the page). Input: ?url= Price: $0.05 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

url.description: Store URL to check before buying (e.g. https://shopify.com)

tools.name: dyoe_audit
tools.description: Use when an agent needs a quick legitimacy and quality read on a website before relying on it. Scores any site 0-100 for legitimacy, trust, SEO and contactability; returns a grade, a legitimacy rating (strong/moderate/weak) and prioritized fixes. Input: ?url=domain Price: $0.05 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_reputation
tools.description: Use when an agent wants a counterparty's track record, not just a fresh check. Look up any domain or wallet: how many times it has been assessed, verdict history, times flagged, first and last seen, a reputation score and a signed credential. Computed only from DYOE's own logged prior assessments; thin history is labeled as such. Input: ?target= Price: $0.05 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

target.description: Domain or wallet to look up history for (e.g. stripe.com)

tools.name: dyoe_credential_org
tools.description: Use when an agent or business needs portable proof that a domain passed a trust check. Issues a signed, independently verifiable credential (valid 7 days) with verdict, trust_score and domain_age_days. Input: ?domain= Price: $0.10 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

domain.description: Business domain to issue a credential for (e.g. stripe.com)

tools.name: dyoe_token
tools.description: Use when a trading agent needs a coin's market data and a read on the project behind it. Returns price, 24h change, market cap and rank, plus project_risk (low/medium/high/unknown) from a scam and rug-risk trust check on the project's official site. Input: ?symbol= Price: $0.05 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_extract
tools.description: Use when a research or summarizing agent needs the readable text of a web page. Extracts clean main text (no scripts, nav, header, footer or forms) with title and word count. Input: ?url= Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

url.description: Page to extract clean text from (e.g. https://stripe.com)

tools.name: dyoe_metadata
tools.description: Use when an agent needs a link preview or a quick read of what a URL is. Extracts title, description, OpenGraph title/image/type, site name, favicon, canonical URL and language. Input: ?url= Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

url.description: Page to read title/description/OG image from (e.g. https://stripe.com)

tools.name: dyoe_crypto
tools.description: Use when a trading agent needs the current price of a coin. Live crypto price + 24h change, market cap & volume for any coin. Input: ?symbol=btc Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_market
tools.description: Use when an agent needs the state of the whole crypto market. Global overview: total market cap, 24h volume and change, BTC/ETH dominance, number of active coins. Input: (none) Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_trending
tools.description: Use when a trading or research agent wants to know which coins are getting attention right now. Returns the top 7 trending coins with symbol, name and market-cap rank. Input: (none) Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_movers
tools.description: Use when a trading agent wants the day's biggest moves. Top 5 gainers and top 5 losers (24h) across the top 100 coins by market cap. Input: (none) Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_fx
tools.description: Use when an agent needs to convert an amount between currencies. Live exchange rate (ECB data) plus the converted amount. Input: ?from=USD&to=EUR&amount=100 Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_weather
tools.description: Use when a travel or planning agent needs the weather in a city. Current conditions (temperature, humidity, wind) + 3-day high/low forecast. Input: ?city=Atlanta Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_wiki
tools.description: Use when a research agent needs a short factual summary of a topic. Returns the Wikipedia summary, short description and page link. Input: ?topic=Bitcoin Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_destination
tools.description: Use when a trip-planning agent is about to book. One call: weather and 3-day forecast, local currency with live FX from USD, and a scam check on the booking site before it pays. Input: ?city=Athens&date=2026-11-20&currency=EUR&booking=hotel-site.com&budget=1500 Price: $0.05 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

booking.description: Booking site domain to safety-check (e.g. booking.com)

tools.name: dyoe_x402_check
tools.description: Use when a seller wants to test their own x402 endpoint the way buyers and indexers see it: returns 402 unpaid, terms parse, payTo valid, price within the $0.10 default client cap, v1 body + v2 header, description under 500 chars, input schema present, response time. Returns pass/warn/fail with a fix list. Free if the URL is bad or unreachable. Input: ?url=https://seller/paid-path&method=GET|POST Price: $0.05 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

url.description: The x402 endpoint to check, with any query it needs (e.g. https://agents.dyoeway.org/verify?target=stripe.com)
